name: Amma's Chicken Curry
description: A deeply spiced, home-style Andhra curry with tender chicken and a glossy onion-tomato gravy.

steps.instruction: Marinate the chicken with turmeric, chilli powder, salt and a spoon of oil for 20 minutes.
Cook the onions slowly until deep golden, then add the chillies and tomatoes.
Add the chicken and cook uncovered until it releases its juices and the masala clings to every piece.
Add a splash of hot water, cover and simmer until tender. Finish with fresh coriander.
